headline: Iran Floating Crude Reserves in Asia Depleted Under US Naval Blockade
summary: Iran's floating crude oil reserves held in Asian waters have run dry following enforcement of a US naval blockade restricting offshore storage and tanker movements, according to the Wall Street Journal.
why: Iran is a significant crude producer; changes in its seaborne inventories impact global physical availability, particularly in Asia.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Depletion of offshore floating reserves reduces supply cushions across Asian import terminals.
